what: Quick instructions for AI coding agents working on ggsegverse
title: Quick instructions for AI coding agents working on ggsegverse
text: Purpose: help AI get productive quickly outlining project’s shape, important files, build/test workflows, repo-specific conventions. ggsegverse tidyverse-style meta-package installs loads ggseg brain visualization ecosystem library(ggsegverse). contain plotting code — orchestrates loading core packages: ggseg.formats, ggseg, ggseg3d, ggseg.hub, neuromapr. design mirrors tidyverse package works: attach core packages, report versions, detect conflicts. ggseg.formats — atlas data structures S3 classes (foundation). ggseg — 2D ggplot2 brain region plotting via geom_brain(). ggseg3d — interactive 3D brain visualization plotly. ggseg.hub — atlas discovery, comparison, installation helpers. neuromapr — spatial null models brain maps. live ggseg GitHub org. ggseg.hub neuromapr yet CRAN; install GitHub local sources. DESCRIPTION — lists core packages Imports; Remotes points GitHub sources packages CRAN. R/attach.R — attachment logic: core_unloaded(), same_library(), ggsegverse_attach(), startup message formatting. R/zzz.R — .onAttach() hook; respects ggsegverse.quiet option suppresses messages testthat runs. R/conflicts.R — ggsegverse_conflicts() detects function name clashes ggseg packages loaded packages. R/update.R — ggsegverse_update(), ggsegverse_deps(), ggsegverse_sitrep() checking installed vs available versions. R/utils.R — ggsegverse_packages() parses DESCRIPTION Imports list core packages; shared helpers. R/ggsegverse-package.R — package-level docs ignore_unused_imports() satisfy R CMD check. Update docs changing roxygen: devtools::document() Run full package checks: devtools::check() Run unit tests: devtools::test() Load interactive testing: devtools::load_all() ggsegverse_packages() — character vector core package names. ggsegverse_conflicts() — detect masked functions. ggsegverse_update() — check outdated packages. ggsegverse_deps() — data frame local vs available versions. ggsegverse_sitrep() — diagnostic overview. print.ggsegverse_conflicts / format.ggsegverse_conflicts — S3 methods conflict display. Tidyverse coding style; use |> pipe existing code . roxygen2 documentation; NAMESPACE auto-generated. code comments except explaining necessary workarounds. Self-explanatory function variable naming. Tests use testthat describe()/() structure. Adding new core package: add DESCRIPTION Imports, add core_packages() R/utils.R, add reference ignore_unused_imports() R/ggsegverse-package.R, add Remotes entry CRAN. Add new core package DESCRIPTION Imports Remotes. Add package name core_packages() R/utils.R. Add one exported symbol reference ignore_unused_imports(). Run devtools::document() devtools::check().

title: ggsegverse: Easily Install and Load the 'ggsegverse' Brain Visualisation Ecosystem — ggsegverse-package
text: Installs loads core packages 'ggsegverse', ecosystem plotting brain atlases mapping data onto brain regions 2D 3D, together 'ggplot2', single call. Also provides helpers find install atlas packages, report package versions, detect namespace conflicts. Learn 'ggsegverse' ecosystem https://ggsegverse.github.io/ggseg/.

title: ggsegverse: Easily Install and Load the 'ggsegverse' Brain Visualisation Ecosystem — ggsegverse-package
text: library(ggsegverse) attaches core packages: ggseg — 2D brain atlas plots geom_brain(). ggseg3d — interactive 3D brain atlas widgets. ggseg.formats — atlas data structures bundled dk(), aseg(), tracula(), suit() atlases. ggseg.meshes — additional cortical cerebellar surface meshes. ggplot2 — plotting grammar ggseg builds . atlases available ggsegverse r-universe; see ggseg_atlas_repos() install_ggseg_atlas(). build atlases, install ggseg.extra separately.
